R7AE-moose-walk-0002.name: 1.7 km S of Hat Lake
R7AE-moose-walk-0002.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7AE-moose-walk-0002.parkWhat: pull off on Arch FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: 8 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 4.2 ha, right here.
Cutblock harvested 2011 (15 years old), 90 m SE: browse.
Moose winter range u-7-018 unit 9 (official), right here. Counts from November.

flags.t: Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: Omineca South and Central. Closed between 4:30 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. from August 15 to August 31, between 5:30 a.m. and 9:00 a.m. from September 1 to September 30 and between 6:30 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. from October 1 to November 15. Synopsis map 7-3/24.

plan: Drive: from District of Mackenzie, about 121 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Coquiwaldie Rd, unsigned, Finlay-Causeway FSR, Finlay-Causeway FSR Bridge.
Park: 54.7576, -124.26299, pull off on Arch FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 370 m NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 3 m, about 8 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-26, Region 7A. Season: moose spike fork bulls Sept 10 to Nov 5 (synopsis page 57, 99%). 2 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-04, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AE-moose-walk-0002.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 7-26: about 2,110 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.63 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.4 km and about 3 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
